question: List the closed jobs.
cypher:
MATCH (j:Job {status: 'CLOSED'})
RETURN j.jobId AS jobId, j.title AS title

question: Which candidates live in Fez?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Candidate)-[:LIVES_IN]->(:City {name: 'Fez'})
RETURN c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name

question: Which skills does candidate C02 claim, with level and verification status?
cypher:
MATCH (:Candidate {candidateId: 'C02'})-[:MAKES_CLAIM]->(cl:SkillClaim)-[:ABOUT_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
RETURN s.name AS skill, cl.level AS level, cl.verificationStatus AS verificationStatus

question: Which candidates claim K8s?
cypher:
MATCH (:Alias {key: toLower('K8s')})-[:ALIAS_OF]->(s:Skill)<-[:ABOUT_SKILL]-(cl:SkillClaim)<-[:MAKES_CLAIM]-(c:Candidate)
RETURN c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name, cl.level AS level, cl.verificationStatus AS verificationStatus

question: What are all the requirements of job J05, mandatory and preferred?
cypher:
MATCH (:Job {jobId: 'J05'})-[r:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
RETURN s.name AS skill, r.priority AS priority, r.minLevel AS minLevel

question: Which candidates meet all mandatory skill requirements of job J06?
cypher:
MATCH (j:Job {jobId: 'J06'})-[:REQUIRES_SKILL {priority: 'MANDATORY'}]->(ms:Skill)
WITH j, count(ms) AS nMand
MATCH (j)-[r:REQUIRES_SKILL {priority: 'MANDATORY'}]->(s:Skill)<-[:ABOUT_SKILL]-(cl:SkillClaim {verificationStatus: 'VERIFIED'})<-[:MAKES_CLAIM]-(c:Candidate)
WHERE cl.level >= r.minLevel
WITH nMand, c, count(DISTINCT s) AS nMet
WHERE nMet = nMand
RETURN c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name

question: Where has candidate C04 worked, and when?
cypher:
MATCH (:Candidate {candidateId: 'C04'})-[:HAS_EXPERIENCE]->(e:WorkExperience)-[:AT_ORGANIZATION]->(o:Organization)
RETURN o.name AS organization, e.roleTitle AS role, e.startDate AS startDate, e.endDate AS endDate
ORDER BY e.startDate

question: Show the full application history of candidate C09 for job J05, in order.
cypher:
MATCH (:Candidate {candidateId: 'C09'})-[:SUBMITTED]->(a:Application)-[:FOR_JOB]->(:Job {jobId: 'J05'}), (a)-[:HAS_EVENT]->(ev:ApplicationEvent)
RETURN ev.type AS type, ev.at AS at
ORDER BY ev.at

question: How many skill claims does each candidate have?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Candidate)-[:MAKES_CLAIM]->(cl:SkillClaim)
RETURN c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name, count(cl) AS claims
ORDER BY claims DESC

question: Which candidates are available onsite in the city of job J06?
cypher:
MATCH (:Job {jobId: 'J06'})-[:BASED_IN]->(city:City)<-[:AVAILABLE_ONSITE_IN]-(c:Candidate)
RETURN c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name, city.name AS city

question: Which work experiences support candidate C03's Machine Learning claim?
cypher:
MATCH (:Candidate {candidateId: 'C03'})-[:MAKES_CLAIM]->(cl:SkillClaim)-[:ABOUT_SKILL]->(:Skill {name: 'Machine Learning'})
MATCH (cl)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(e:WorkExperience)-[:AT_ORGANIZATION]->(o:Organization)
RETURN e.experienceId AS experienceId, e.roleTitle AS role, o.name AS organization

question: Which jobs are published by organizations located in Casablanca?
cypher:
MATCH (j:Job)-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(o:Organization)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:City {name: 'Casablanca'})
RETURN j.jobId AS jobId, j.title AS title, o.name AS organization

question: Who assessed candidate C01's Python skill, and when?
cypher:
MATCH (:Candidate {candidateId: 'C01'})-[:MAKES_CLAIM]->(cl:SkillClaim)-[:ABOUT_SKILL]->(:Skill {name: 'Python'})
MATCH (sa:SkillAssessment)-[:ASSESSES]->(cl)
OPTIONAL MATCH (sa)-[:ASSESSED_BY]->(a:Assessor)
RETURN sa.assessedAt AS assessedAt, sa.level AS level, a.name AS assessor
ORDER BY sa.assessedAt

question: Which candidates worked at a company in the same city where they live?
cypher:
MATCH (c:Candidate)-[:LIVES_IN]->(city:City)<-[:LOCATED_IN]-(o:Organization)<-[:AT_ORGANIZATION]-(:WorkExperience)<-[:HAS_EXPERIENCE]-(c)
RETURN DISTINCT c.candidateId AS candidateId, c.name AS name, city.name AS city
